No, adding one more 3-credit elective is not allowed for you at this time. 

Here are the details regarding your request:
* **Add/Drop Period:** Courses may only be added or dropped during the add/drop period, which ended on 10 Aug 2026 [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4]. After the add/drop period, no course can be added [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4]. Today's date is 23 Nov 2026, which is outside the add/drop window [SQL].
* **Credit Limits:** While your CGPA of 8.82 qualifies you for a credit overload of up to 28 credits (since CGPA 8.82 ≥ 8.5) [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §3], and you currently have 25 registered credits [SQL], the restriction against adding courses after the add/drop period still applies [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §4].
sql: SELECT SUM(c.credits) AS total_registered_credits, CASE WHEN CAST('2026-11-23' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2027-01-15' AS DATE) THEN 'Within add/drop period' ELSE 'Outside add/drop period' END AS add_drop_status FROM enrollments AS e JOIN courses AS c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.student_id = 'S2023ENTC001' AND e.term = '2026-ODD' AND e.status = 'enrolled' LIMIT 200
